title: Verify Shutdown Staging Mapping for AGVs With Tote vs Without Tote Using the ShutDownStaging Table
summary: Use SSMS/Helix DB (WCS) to validate that the ShutDownStaging table maps shutdown destinations correctly based on whether an AGV has a tote (tote=true) versus no tote (tote=false), including the expected use of ShutdownOffTheEndId and center queue staging for tote-carrying AGVs, and the expected sorter-location/nearest-open-available shutdown queue behavior for non-tote AGVs. Also confirm that the ShutDownStaging Sequence values align with the zone/entrance sequence behavior used to select the correct shutdown queue destination.
when_to_use: When you need to troubleshoot or confirm that AGVs stage correctly during shutdown, specifically validating that tote-carrying AGVs and non-tote AGVs are routed to the correct shutdown staging destinations per the ShutDownStaging table mapping rules (including off-the-end queue vs nearest open available shutdown queue behavior) and that Sequence mapping is consistent.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the SSMS/Helix DB (WCS) checks against the ShutDownStaging table and determine whether mappings for tote=true vs tote=false and Sequence behavior are consistent with expected shutdown staging logic.
access_or_tools_needed: SSMS / Helix DB (WCS / Helix DB (SSMS)) access to the OptiSweep/WCS database that contains the shutdown staging model table

system_preconditions: The OptiSweep/WCS database is reachable from SSMS/Helix DB and contains the shutdown staging model/table named ShutDownStaging (or the exact table/model name used in the database schema).

steps.title: Validate tote=true rows map to ShutdownOffTheEndid and center queue staging (ShutdownQueueld)
steps.purpose: Confirm that AGVs carrying a tote (tote=true) are mapped to the expected shutdown off-the-end queue destination and center queue staging destination.
steps.instruction: In ShutDownStaging, review rows where WithTote / tote=true and confirm they map to a shutdown off-the-end queue destination (ShutdownOffTheEndid) and a center queue staging destination (ShutdownQueueld / center queue staging fields as shown in the table).
steps.expected_result: For tote=true rows, ShutdownOffTheEndid is populated with an off-the-end queue destination and ShutdownQueueld is populated with the center queue staging destination.
steps.healthy_condition: tote=true rows include mappings for both ShutdownOffTheEndid (off-the-end queue) and ShutdownQueueld (center queue staging).
steps.failure_condition: tote=true rows are missing ShutdownOffTheEndid mappings (off-the-end queue destination not mapped) or missing center queue staging mappings (ShutdownQueueld not mapped).

steps.title: Validate tote=false rows map to sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior
steps.purpose: Confirm that AGVs without a tote (tote=false) are mapped to sorter locations rather than the off-the-end queue path, matching the expected nearest open available shutdown queue behavior.
steps.instruction: In ShutDownStaging, review rows where WithTote / tote=false and confirm they map to sorter locations (i.e., the destination is mapped to sorter locations rather than the shutdown off-the-end queue path).
steps.expected_result: For tote=false rows, the mapped destination corresponds to sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior rather than the off-the-end queue path used for tote=true.
steps.healthy_condition: tote=false rows are not routed through the off-the-end queue destination path; they map to sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior.
steps.failure_condition: tote=false rows are mapped to the off-the-end queue path instead of sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior.

actions.exact_action: Review rows that correspond to AGVs without tote (tote=false) and confirm they map to sorter locations (i.e., the destination is mapped to sorter locations rather than the shutdown off-the-end queue path).

steps.title: Check Sequence behavior aligns with zone/entrance sequence selection of shutdown queue destination
steps.purpose: Ensure the ShutDownStaging Sequence values are consistent so the system can select the correct shutdown queue destination for a given zone/entrance sequence.
steps.instruction: In ShutDownStaging, check that the table uses a sequence value (Sequence / sequence #) that matches the AGV’s zone/entrance sequence so the system can select the correct shutdown queue destination.
steps.expected_result: Sequence values in ShutDownStaging are present and consistent such that a given zone/entrance sequence selects the corresponding shutdown queue destination.
steps.healthy_condition: Sequence values are populated and align with the described 'zone/sequence selects shutdown queue destination' behavior.
steps.failure_condition: Sequence values are missing or inconsistent such that zone/sequence cannot reliably select the correct shutdown queue destination.

actions.label: Verify Sequence mapping

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if sequence values do not align with the described “zone/sequence selects shutdown queue destination” behavior (e.g., sequence rows are missing or inconsistent).

steps.title: Stop and escalate on mapping or sequence inconsistencies
steps.purpose: Ensure incorrect shutdown staging mappings are promptly escalated when they violate the expected tote vs non-tote routing rules or sequence behavior.
steps.instruction: If any of the validation checks fail (tote=true missing ShutdownOffTheEndid, tote=false routed to off-the-end queue path, or Sequence behavior inconsistent), stop further analysis and escalate.
steps.expected_result: A clear escalation decision is made based on the specific failing condition(s).
steps.healthy_condition: All checks pass: tote=true rows include ShutdownOffTheEndid and center queue staging; tote=false rows map to sorter locations/nearest open available shutdown queue behavior; Sequence values align with zone/entrance selection behavior.
steps.failure_condition: Any of the specified mapping/sequence failures are present.

actions.label: Escalate mapping/sequence issue
actions.exact_action: Stop and escalate if the table shows tote=true rows missing ShutdownOffTheEndid mappings, or if tote=false rows are mapped to the off-the-end queue path instead of sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior.

success_criteria: In ShutDownStaging, tote=true rows include a mapped ShutdownOffTheEndid (off-the-end queue destination) and a mapped center queue staging destination (ShutdownQueueld).
In ShutDownStaging, tote=false rows are mapped to sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior rather than the off-the-end queue path.
ShutDownStaging Sequence values are present and align with the described zone/entrance sequence behavior used to select the correct shutdown queue destination.
healthy_conditions: tote=true rows show both ShutdownOffTheEndid and ShutdownQueueld mappings.
tote=false rows map to sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior (not the off-the-end queue path).
Sequence values support correct shutdown queue destination selection for the zone/entrance sequence.
failure_conditions: tote=false rows mapped to the off-the-end queue path instead of sorter locations / nearest open available shutdown queue behavior.
Sequence values missing or inconsistent with zone/sequence selection behavior.
escalation_guidance: Escalate when ShutDownStaging violates tote=true vs tote=false mapping expectations (ShutdownOffTheEndid missing for tote=true; off-the-end queue path used for tote=false) or when Sequence behavior is inconsistent/missing.
